notes: Shopify store design-public.myshopify.com. Collection grids are rendered client-side by the Algolia Shopify app (instant_search_enabled_on_collection=true), so no product count appears in the server HTML. Counts were taken from the same Algolia query the page issues (index shopify_dp_products, facetFilters collections:<handle>, distinct=true, which de-duplicates the per-variant records); all returned exhaustiveNbHits=true. Cross-validated against full /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 enumeration: vases 80=80, chandeliers 49=49, serveware 38=38. Note /collections.json products_count is consistently higher (e.g. vases 137) because it counts products not live in the Online Store channel; it was NOT used. Excluded per brief: Clocks and Clocks & Mirrors, Blankets/Pillows/Throws/Rugs (textiles), Baskets & Bins, Hooks/Racks, Wastebaskets, Wall Shelves & Ledges, Flatware & Utensils, Linens & Napkin Holders, Wine Racks and Bar Carts, Bulbs and Tools & Supplies, all furniture, the Workspace department, and the Kitchen department (36 products, mostly kitchen tools, wastebaskets and hand towels). Brand/designer pages and Shop All / New / Sale / Quick Ship were skipped. Sub-category names follow each collection page title (verified live via the translate.goog proxy; the origin was rate-limiting our IP with a 429 'Verifying your connection' page at the time, which is throttling, not a bot block). | ORCHESTRATOR: dropped the 'Art + Wall Decor' (255) row - the worker reported its composition as ~88 mirrors + 22 clocks + 11 wall decor + ~134 wall shelves & ledges, i.e. a majority of out-of-scope shelving plus explicitly-excluded clocks. Spec rule: take only the decorative sub-categories from a mixed parent. Mirrors (88) and Artwork (4) remain as their own rows.
